conditional_exactness: Sufficient: C1_physical = K1_enlarged + sigma1(K1_enlarged), and C2_physical = K2_enlarged. Neither equality is proved by this compiler.
frame_selection: Both C1 stabilizer frames are retained; one C2 frame per orientation/omission pair suffices under the stated whole-C2 coverage gate. No equality with an all128-C2 enlarged outer is assumed.
coefficient_convention: [k,i,j,value], upper triangle mirrored; k=0 constant, k=1..8 original visible coordinates, k=9+j auxiliary j.
source_geometry: 128 C1 frames,64 C2 frames,64 adjacent and32 opposite exact closed faces,16 original nonsignaling event inequalities.
public_scope: This is NOT an exact lift of the full eight-coordinate quantum set.
